title: Sahara Refund Portal Online Registration 2023
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit the official Sahara Refund portal (as notified by Ministry of Cooperation / CRCS)
2. Register with Aadhaar and mobile
3. Enter deposit / certificate details carefully
4. Upload identity and deposit proofs
5. Submit and track refund status online
shortDescription: Sahara Refund Portal Online Registration 2023 – depositors register for refund claims on the official government portal.
content:
The Sahara Refund Portal was launched for genuine depositors of Sahara group cooperative societies to register claims for refund as per Supreme Court / government directions.

Applicants must use only official portals, enter correct deposit certificate numbers, and keep Aadhaar-linked bank details ready. Beware of fake refund websites and agents.
